cases.text: bb_index mode=file refused: another index run is already active for this project (pid 999999 on host pop-os, started 2026-11-03T00:57:30.000Z, kind=index); the lock file records no start time, so the holder cannot be identified — pid 999999 may be a RECYCLED pid belonging to a process that did not take the lock. Remove it by hand if that run is gone: rm /home/ishaq2321/mcp/backbencher-brain/validation/tools/bb_index/bbdata/projects/069354f5b81f8d1bc3ca023fb4083087b59e40bf/.index.lock

bbIndex.pathDescription: Project-relative file (reindex only that file) or directory (incremental index of changed files); for mode=post, the project whose derived phases should be re-run. REQUIRED in every mode, and for mode=post it is checked rather than ignored. Must resolve INSIDE the project: both sides are resolved through realpath, so a symlink inside the project pointing out of it is refused too.
